mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM admin_audit_log WHERE action_name='withdrawal.review' AND target_id=#{id})

SELECT EXISTS (
SELECT 1 FROM merchant_transfer_channel c JOIN merchant_identity i ON i.merchant_id=#{accountId} AND i.app_id=c.app_id AND i.open_id=c.recipient_open_id JOIN wechat_config cfg ON cfg.id=(SELECT MAX(id) FROM wechat_config) AND cfg.merchant_app_id=c.app_id AND cfg.merchant_no=c.merchant_no
SELECT 1 FROM rider_transfer_channel c JOIN rider_identity i ON i.id=#{accountId} AND i.app_id=c.app_id AND i.openid=COALESCE(c.recipient_open_id,i.openid) AND i.openid<>'' JOIN wechat_config cfg ON cfg.id=(SELECT MAX(id) FROM wechat_config) AND cfg.rider_app_id=c.app_id AND cfg.merchant_no=c.merchant_no
WHERE c.withdrawal_id=#{id} AND c.channel_state IN ('FAIL','CANCELLED'))
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rider_transfer_channel WHERE withdrawal_id=#{id})

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM rider_transfer_channel c JOIN withdrawal_transfer t ON t.withdrawal_id=c.withdrawal_id WHERE c.withdrawal_id=#{id} AND c.app_id=#{appId} AND c.merchant_no=#{merchantNo} AND c.channel_state='UNKNOWN' AND c.package_info IS NULL AND t.status IN ('PROCESSING','UNKNOWN') AND t.channel_reference IS NULL AND NOT t.retry_requested AND t.created_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP-INTERVAL 30 DAY )
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(frozen_delta),0) FROM account_journal WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND reference_id=#{id}
